buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 3. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 4. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 2 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training,

Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Applicable Terms & Acceptance: All bidders must comply with GeM GTC, STC, published bid conditions, these ATC and all corrigenda. The bidder shall submit a consolidated declaration accepting all such terms and conditions. 2. Scope & Specifications: All items must strictly conform to the specifications and requirements mentioned in the bid. 3. Technical Offer & Compliance: Bidders must submit complete item-wise technical details, including manufacturer, brand, model and applicable HSN/SAC cod e, supported by relevant datasheets or catalogues. 4. Quality Standards: All supplied products must be new, unused, genuine and free from defects. 5. Item Requirements: The bid covers Kitchenware, Furniture, Electrical Items and Books. 6. Delivery, Inspection & Scope of Supply: Goods must be delivered within the stipulated period and shall be subject to inspection. The offer must include the c omplete published scope, including accessories, packing, transportation, insurance, unloading, installation, testing, commissioning and training wherever specifi ed. 7. Defective Goods: Any defective or damaged goods must be replaced or rectified by the supplier at no additional cost. 8. Warranty: A minimum of 2 years of comprehensive warranty must be provided. 9. Price Declaration & Cost Inclusion: All quoted prices must be inclusive of applicable taxes, freight, transportation, installation, warranty and other specified c harges. No separate or additional charges shall be levied. Taxes and charges must be disclosed in the prescribed financial format. Prices shall not be disclosed i n the technical bid of a two-packet tender. 10. Document Submission: All required documents must be uploaded through the GeM portal. Submission of all prescribed financial and supporting documents is mandatory. 11. Non-Blacklisting Declaration: A declaration on ₹100 non-judicial stamp paper confirming that the bidder has not been blacklisted by any Government Depar tment or organization must be submitted. 12. Income Tax Returns: ITR documents for the last 3 financial years must be submitted. 13. Balance Sheets: Audited balance sheets for the last 3 financial years must be submitted. 14. GST Returns: GST returns for the last 6 months must be submitted. 15. GST Certificate: A valid GST registration certificate must be submitted. 16. PAN Card: A copy of the bidder's PAN card must be submitted. 17.EMD: Payment of EMD through Demand Draft (DD) is mandatory. Bids submitted without EMD payment through DD shall not be considered. 18. No Relaxation: No exemption or relaxation shall be granted on the basis of MSME or Startup status in respect of experience, turnover, EMD or any other eligi bility criteria, subject to applicable GeM rules and Government procurement policies. 19. Establishment Registration: Shops and Establishments Registration or other relevant establishment registration shall be submitted wherever legally applica ble. Otherwise, the bidder shall provide a declaration explaining non-applicability. 20. Product Certifications: Valid BIS licences/registrations and other statutory product approvals shall be submitted wherever applicable to the offered goods or expressly required under permissible bid specifications. 21. Service Support, Repair & Maintenance: The bidder shall provide details of service support arrangements at the buyer's location, including relevant service centres, contact persons and complaint registration procedures. Response and resolution timelines shall comply with the bid. 22. Financial Standing & Insolvency: The bidder shall disclose any insolvency, liquidation, receivership or similar proceedings relevant to its eligibility or ability t o perform the contract. Such disclosures shall be evaluated under applicable provisions and published conditions. 23. No Malicious Code: For applicable IT and electronic products, the bidder shall submit the prescribed undertaking regarding malicious code and comply with software and firmware integrity requirements specified in the bid. 24. Conflict of Interest: The bidder shall disclose any personal, family or business relationship or arrangement that creates a conflict of interest in this procurem ent. Where none exists, a declaration to that effect shall be submitted

25.Site Familiarisation: Where site conditions are relevant, bidders may inspect the delivery or installation location through arrangements available equally to a ll interested bidders. A site visit certificate mandatory under this ATC 26.Make in India Compliance: Wherever applicable, the bidder shall submit the prescribed local-content declaration, supplier classification and supporting certification. Purchase preference shall be applied according to the policy applicable to this procurement. .

1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Defective Goods: Any defective or damaged goods must be replaced or rectified by the supplier at no additional cost. 8. Warranty: A minimum of 2 years of comprehensive warranty must be provided. 9. Price Declaration & Cost Inclusion: All quoted prices must be inclusive of applicable taxes, freight, transportation, installation, warranty and other specified c harges.
